club.label: Doors open / check-in
club.description: Self check-in at race control. Tick your name off before practising.

club.label: Open practice
club.description: The track opens when the race director says, normally at 08:30. Open practice runs until 09:30.

club.label: Controlled practice
club.description: 3-minute controlled practice following the drivers’ briefing.

club.label: Qualifying
club.description: Four qualifying rounds. Guide starts: round 1 10:20, round 2 11:25, round 3 12:30 and round 4 13:40. Based on the last three Club Days (8–10 heats); fewer heats can bring the day forward.

club.label: Finals
club.description: Recent Club Days started finals between about 14:30 and 15:20. Allow time after qualifying for race control to arrange finals, print listings and issue car numbers. Follow the announced race order.

club.label: Track pack-away
club.description: The last three Club Days finished racing between 15:20 and 16:25. Pack-away follows the final race; this is not a guaranteed leaving time. Any help is appreciated—many hands make light work.

sword.label: Doors open / check-in
sword.description: Self check-in at race control. Tick your name off when you arrive.

sword.label: Controlled practice
sword.description:
3-minute controlled practice. First practice on the line normally at 08:50. No open practice.

After first practice, there may be some slight adjustment to the heats. Please confirm your car number and heat have not changed.

sword.label: Qualifying
sword.description: Four qualifying rounds. Guide starts: round 1 09:45, round 2 11:05, round 3 12:25 and round 4 13:45. Based on the six rounds of 2025/26; 10–12 heats usually need about 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 25 minutes per round. Smaller meetings can run differently.

sword.label: Finals
sword.description: Recent SWORD finals began between about 14:40 and 15:30. Allow around 10–20 minutes after qualifying to arrange finals, print listings and fit car numbers; follow race control on the day.

sword.label: Awards and photographs
sword.description: Award boards for the top three in each final. We aim to take photographs of the top three once they have completed their marshalling duties.

sword.label: Track pack-away
sword.description: For a typical 10–12-heat meeting, allow until around 16:20–17:00 for racing, then marshalling, awards and pack-away. Smaller meetings may finish earlier; delays can extend the day. Any help packing away is appreciated.
